verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own Crawl API retrieves and extracts content from multiple pages in a single request, a first-party bulk operation. A community comment also notes generous concurrency. The evidence covers only crawling linked pages from a starting URL, not general bulk operations across arbitrary item sets. Missing for 10: a documented batch API for submitting many URLs or tasks at once, bulk session or agent-task management, documented concurrency limits for bulk jobs, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
